Celebrations

Mayra Evening

Fri · 01 May 4:00 PM 3rd Floor Hall

A tender family ritual of blessings and heirlooms — where her maternal home sends love forward into the new one.

Fri · 01 May 7:00 PM Open Terrace

Laughter in the air, dhol echoing under the stars, and a courtyard of music that drifts long into the night.

Tamil Carnival

Sat · 02 May 10:00 AM Pool Side Lawn

A joyful morning of silks, kolam patterns, filter-coffee fragrance and banana-leaf feasting.

Milni & Phera

Reception Evening

Need to Know

Questions

Mayra: Traditional · Musical Night: Comfortable wear · Tamil Carnival: South Indian attire · Sangeet: Indo-Western · Milni & Phera: Indian traditional · Reception: Suit or Blazer. See the Dress Code section above for watercolour references.
Yes — ample parking is available on the Ponneri Gymkhana Club grounds, with valet support during the Sangeet and Reception evenings.
We have held rooms at two partner hotels in Ponneri and northern Chennai. A stay-and-shuttle detail is being shared with guests via WhatsApp — reach out to the families if you haven't received it yet.
Post to Instagram, WhatsApp Status or your channel of choice with the hashtag #EkRahForever — we'll be collecting every tagged moment into a shared album for the families after the weekend.
For RSVPs or any special requirement — dietary, accessibility, travel — please reach us on +91 86514 73405. Call or WhatsApp anytime; we'd love to make sure your stay is effortless.
